purpose: Register and interconnect the latest worldwide video super-resolution research so each specialty has multiple independent experts and a reserve pool.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: SeedVR2
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: Official repository describes one-step diffusion-transformer video restoration capable of arbitrary output resolution.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: FlashVSR
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: one-step streaming diffusion VSR, sparse attention, reported 17 FPS at 768x1408 on one A100 and claims scaling to ultra-high resolutions.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: PS-SR
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: asymmetric speculative sampling plus frequency-domain update to preserve low-frequency structure while refining high-frequency detail.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: DGAF-VSR
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: optical-guided warping and feature-wise temporal conditioning; reports improvements in perceptual quality, fidelity and temporal consistency.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: STCDiT
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: motion-aware VAE segmentation and anchor-frame guidance to improve structural fidelity and temporal stability.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: TextOVSR
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: degradation-descriptive and content-descriptive text guidance for restoration of degraded performance video.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: TIGER
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: two-stage text-first/image-later restoration using glyph structure guidance.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: DTG-Restore
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: training-free decoupled time guidance for structure correction and detail refinement, plug-and-play with restoration modules.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: CreativeVR
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026 workshop: diffusion-prior-guided structure and motion restoration for real and generative video.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: Time Without Time
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: pseudo-temporal pretraining that improves space-time reconstruction and cross-frame aggregation.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: VSRELL
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: CVPR 2026: illumination-sensitive propagation to reduce flicker and error accumulation while preserving texture fidelity.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: TS-Mamba
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: ICLR 2026 trajectory-aware shifted state space model for online VSR.

newOrRevalidatedCandidates.name: VSRM
newOrRevalidatedCandidates.evidence: State-space video restoration research line; retain as non-authoritative candidate pending license and reproducibility audit.

meshRules.routing: Select at least two independent experts for each eligible specialty and a third when confidence is low or methods disagree.
meshRules.parallelMode: Run experts independently on identical source windows before fusion.
meshRules.fallback: On material disagreement, prefer the most conservative evidence-preserving result and retain disagreement metadata.
meshRules.reservePool: Enable additional candidates when confidence falls below threshold, motion is complex, text is present, or artifacts are detected.

extremeResolutionRules.method: overlapping spatial-temporal tiles with multi-pass optional processing
extremeResolutionRules.claimRule: 36K/48K is a delivery target only; no claim of recovered factual detail without evidence.

researchNotes: DGAF-VSR reports a 35.82% DISTS reduction, 0.20 dB PSNR gain and 30.37% tLPIPS reduction against cited baselines; these figures are benchmark-specific and not proof of 36K/48K fidelity.
STCDiT explicitly targets structural fidelity and temporal stability under complex camera motion.
PS-SR uses frequency-domain control to preserve low-frequency content while refining high-frequency details.
FlashVSR emphasizes scalability and speed, while its reported 17 FPS result is tied to a specific 768x1408/A100 setup.
ITU-T P.910 (07/26) was approved 2026-07-29 and is the current in-force prepublished revision for subjective multimedia video quality assessment.
